knowledge_gaps: Deleting recent events also removes the latest item, whereas deleting old events preserves it. The proposed comparison cannot distinguish dependence on the latest item from dependence on broader recent context. Add a last-item-only reference and a perturbation that preserves the latest item.

Final-nonpadding readout does not ensure correct GRU padding behavior: recurrent biases can update hidden states during leading padding. Verify that the supplied backbone handles padding consistently across original and shortened histories before interpreting sensitivity.

Reproduction requires an explicit user sample size and selection rule, candidate tie policy, bootstrap replicate count, paired-effect sign convention, and runtime cap. The per-category adapter also needs a specified external aggregation step for macro estimates and uncertainty.

The report correctly labels training-prefix targets as in-sample, but memorization can still obscure temporal effects. These diagnostics should generate hypotheses; any subsequent training intervention must earn its selection through pinned validation HR@10.

Originality 4/10 is reasonable for an established perturbation method. Potential 7/10 is provisional without measured utility, and difficulty 3/10 may underestimate padding verification, scoring-interface compatibility, and cross-category aggregation.
